title: Thrusting a hand into Stephen’s upper pocket
html_source:
The impertinence of Mulligan’s character is exemplified here – he acts before asking, displaying his impatience and rudeness towards his own roommate.

On a side note, it is interesting that someone so inconsiderate and rude would be a medical student – a career path that you would hope is associated with altruism and philanthropy, instead of the blatant disregard for emotion and comfort portrayed by Mulligan.
